description_en: Queries the detailed information about a database
description_zh: 获取指定数据库的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-database --instance-id bastionhost-cn-wwo36qbv601 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --database-id 21 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDatabase

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host that manages the database to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的数据库所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host that manages the database to query.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的数据库所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the database to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758822.html operation to query the database ID
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的数据库ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758822.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: database_id

Database.description_en: The returned detailed information about the database
Database.description_zh: 查询到的数据库实例详细信息

ActiveAddressType.description_en:
The address type of the database. Valid values:

Public

Private
ActiveAddressType.description_zh:
数据库实例地址类型。取值：

Public ：公网地址
Private ：私网地址

DatabasePrivateAddress.description_en: The internal endpoint of the database
DatabasePrivateAddress.description_zh: 数据库实例的私网地址

DatabasePublicAddress.description_en: The public endpoint of the database
DatabasePublicAddress.description_zh: 数据库实例的公网地址

DatabaseType.description_en:
The database engine. Valid values:

mysql

sqlserver

postgresql

oracle
DatabaseType.description_zh:
数据库类型。取值：
mysql
sqlserver
postgresql
oracle

NetworkDomainId.description_en: The ID of the network domain to which the database belongs
NetworkDomainId.description_zh: 数据库所属的网络域的ID

Source.description_en:
The database type. Valid values:

Local: on-premises database.

Rds: ApsaraDB RDS instance.

PolarDB: PolarDB cluster
Source.description_zh:
指定新创建数据库实例的来源。取值：

Local：本地数据库实例
Rds：RDS类型数据库实例
PolarDB: PolarDB类型数据库实例

SourceInstanceId.description_en:
The ID of the ApsaraDB RDS instance or PolarDB cluster.

If Source is set to Local, this parameter is empty
SourceInstanceId.description_zh:
数据库对应的RDS实例ID或PolarDB实例ID。
Source为Local时，该参数返回值为空

SourceInstanceRegionId.description_en: The region ID of the ApsaraDB RDS instance or PolarDB cluster
SourceInstanceRegionId.description_zh: 数据库对应的RDS实例或PolarDB实例所在的区域ID

SourceInstanceState.description_en:
The status of the database. Valid values:

Normal

Release
SourceInstanceState.description_zh:
数据库实例状态。取值：
Normal：正常
Release：已释放

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
